summary: Closed by a later wave. packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/services/transients/transient_alert_mapper.dart:48 now passes `magnitude: null` (the cited `final magnitude = detection.deltaMag?.abs();` at :20 is gone), and the delta is carried as a labelled brightness change in the classification/notes instead (:31-36, :55-64). Six regression tests already cover it.

title: Confirming a First Light candidate does not update the Observing Alerts tab beside it
summary: Closed by a later wave, at the location the verifier corrected to (not the one the finding named). packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/providers/transient_alert_provider.dart:924-929 adds `resolveTransientAlertState(alert, overrides) => overrides[alert.id] ?? alert.state`, and transients_screen.dart:180 (card badge) and :213/:219/:225 (_filterAlerts) both route through it, so the mapper's `acknowledged` is live on that surface. unacknowledgedAlertCountProvider:950 uses it too.

title: The cull rail advertises 'Keep best 1 (+0%)' from a curve it already knows is stale; pressing it always refuses
summary: Closed by a later wave, exactly as the finding asked. The population-vs-accepted + gain test was lifted out of the press handler into SessionReviewController.cullRecommendationOffer (session_review_controller.dart:1536-1581), and cullToRecommended():1590-1598 now switches on that same getter, so render-time and press-time can never disagree. sub_cull_rail.dart:289 passes the action only when `_offer.isOfferable`; :503-521 render 'Cull analysis out of date' / 'Keep-set already optimal' chips (with the population vs accepted counts) instead of a quantified button. The rail re-renders on staleness because it listens to the controller and tracks the offer, not the curve (:105-118). I closed one residual in that fix: the alreadyOptimal chip's tooltip read 'The optimizer would keep all N accepted subs - there is nothing to cull' for BOTH of the states that produce that status, but one of them is `predictedSnrGainPct <= 0` with keepN < population - where the optimizer did pick a smaller keep-set, it just predicts no benefit. On the exact scenario the finding reported (keepN 1 over 4 subs, +0%) the chip therefore swapped the false 'Keep best 1 (+0%)' for a different false claim. sub_cull_rail.dart:515-534 now branches on keepN >= populationSize and says which case it is.
test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/session_review/sub_cull_rail_stale_curve_test.dart - 4 tests pass (stale renders the chip not 'Keep best'; alreadyOptimal likewise; a matching population does render 'Keep best 2 (+7%)'; rejecting a sub after integration flips the live rail to the chip without replacing the curve). Extended: 'a curve promising no gain renders no "+0%" action even though its population matches' now reads the rendered Tooltip and asserts it says 'would keep 1 of 4' / 'no SNR gain' and NOT 'keep all'; new sibling 'when the keep-set really does cover every sub, the chip says so' keeps the true sentence alive. 5 tests.
revert_check: Reverted sub_cull_rail.dart:288-289 `onCullToRecommended: _offer.isOfferable ? () => _cullToRecommended(_offer) : null,` to an unconditional `() => _cullToRecommended(_offer)`. 4 tests failed; restored, all pass. Separately, restoring the single unconditional 'would keep all $acceptedCount accepted subs' tooltip at sub_cull_rail.dart:515-534 fails 'a curve promising no gain renders no "+0%" action...'; restored, 5 pass.
caveats: packages/skotiq_app test/screens/session_review + test/screens/stack_result: 92 passed, 2 failed - both are captures_landscape_test.dart golden pixel diffs on the STACK RESULT screen (1.78%), caused by other agents' same-day design-system edits (skotiq_ui status_pill/card/switch/checkbox 22:46, skotiq_chip 23:30). My only app-side edit is a Tooltip string inside the session-review cull rail, which is not on that screen. Per the repo rule, Linux-regenerated goldens were NOT committed.

title: The 'Maximum Quality' integration profile is a placebo -- it produces byte-identical settings to Balanced
summary: Closed by a later wave. integration_settings.dart:754-757 now returns `ransacThresholdPx: 1.0, maxRefStars: 120, normalization: NormalizationMode.local` instead of restating the five constructor defaults balanced already inherits. These are not cosmetic: all three ride the bridge map (:949-961 'ransacThresholdPx'/'maxRefStars'/normalization.mode) and are consumed natively - post_session.rs:1764-1768 writes them into cfg.ransac_threshold_px / cfg.max_stars_for_matching, and registration.rs:323,:705 filters the transform fit on the threshold.
test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/session_review/integration_settings_panel_test.dart - 'Maximum Quality actually costs something over Balanced', 'no two integration profiles produce the same stack', 'the readout names the knobs the active profile changes'.
revert_check: Reverted the maximumQuality arm at integration_settings.dart:753-758 to `const IntegrationSettings(sourcePreset: IntegrationPreset.maximumQuality)`. 3 tests failed; restored, all pass.
caveats: Worth flagging for the owner rather than churning: the wave chose ransacThresholdPx 1.0 where the finding proposed 1.5. registration.rs:322-332 drops any correspondence outside the threshold and errors NoConsistentGeometry below min_inliers, so on poor seeing this profile will legitimately register fewer frames than Balanced. That is the documented trade of the profile (and the shortfall is reported - see session_review_integration_shortfall_test.dart), but it is a behaviour change, not just a label change.

title: Running an A/B recipe preview leaves a full 'Preview... 100%' progress bar pinned under the header forever
summary: Closed by a later wave, and centrally rather than per-action. session_review_controller.dart:636-642 adds `_withLiveProgress`, a try/finally that clears the strip on success, failure and every early-out; reIntegratePreview() wraps its body in it at :1122, and so do integrate() (:857), _runFinishingStep (:1349 - the path runColorCalibration/runBackgroundExtraction/runDeconvolve/runStarReduction take) and runNarrowband (:1426). The terminal 1.0 that _bindProgress deliberately leaves up can no longer outlive the action that raised it.
test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/session_review/session_review_progress_strip_test.dart - 6 tests ('the preview progress strip is torn down when reIntegratePreview returns' and siblings).
revert_check: Replaced the `_withLiveProgress(() async {...})` wrapper in reIntegratePreview (session_review_controller.dart:1122) with a bare `(() async {...})()`. 6 tests failed; restored, all pass.

title: A single sub that fails alignment aborts the entire Stack & Share run and deletes the partial result
summary: Two parts. (a) The abort itself was already closed by a later wave: stack_and_share_service.dart:399-431 wraps the `_addStackFrame` await (the exact line the finding cited) in a try/catch that counts the frame, records the reason, emits progress and `continue`s; only authority loss still propagates. A run whose followers are ALL refused throws StackAndShareAllFramesRejectedException naming the dominant reason (:459-465) instead of persisting a one-sub 'stack'. (b) I closed the residual that fix left: the completed run still quoted `selection.totalIntegrationSecs`, which stack_light_selector.dart:211 fixes BEFORE the engine has seen a frame, so every stack that rejected anything overstated its integration time - on the result screen ('Integration'), in the AstroBin sidecar and on the Share Card the user posts publicly. Before the wave-4 fix this was unreachable (the run died); after it, it is the normal path. Added StackedFrameSelection.exposureSecs (stack_and_share_models.dart:293-301), populated it in the selector (stack_light_selector.dart:259), and totalled it over `integratedImageIds` - the set already used for avgHfr - via _integratedIntegrationSecs (stack_and_share_service.dart:725-748), used at :542. Identical to the old value when nothing is rejected: both sum the same per-frame exposure.
test: packages/skotiq_core/test/services/stack_and_share_service_test.dart: 'a rejected follower is counted and skipped; the run continues' now also asserts result.integrationSecs == 240 (4 of 5 x 60s subs integrated) AND that the persisted row carries the same value; new sibling 'with nothing rejected the integration time is the whole selection' guards against over-correcting. packages/skotiq_core/test/services/stack_light_selector_test.dart: the selector test now asserts every survivor carries its own exposureSecs.
revert_check: Three reverts. (1) stack_and_share_service.dart:542 back to `integrationSecs: selection.totalIntegrationSecs,` -> 'a rejected follower is counted and skipped; the run continues' failed. (2) Removed `exposureSecs: frame.exposureDuration,` from stack_light_selector.dart:259 -> 'selectForSession keeps lights only, honours accepted + quality gates' failed. (3) Replaced the try/catch at :399-431 with the bare `await _addStackFrame(...)` -> the two rejection tests failed. All restored; stack_and_share_service_test 23 pass, stack_light_selector_test 12 pass.
caveats: Whole-package gate: `flutter test` in packages/skotiq_core = 5422 passed, 4 skipped, 6 failed - all 6 in test/services/import/nina_sequence_fidelity_test.dart with 'SequenceImportValidationFailedException: Wait Has No Time Set', from another agent's concurrent edit to lib/src/providers/sequence/rules/timing_rules.dart (mtime 23:16, before this session's first edit). Nothing in the stack/share, share-card or transient areas failed. dart analyze clean on every file I touched.

title: Registration reports a 10.34px alignment residual for a pure 2.2px translation of the same 40-star field
summary: Closed by a later wave, and at the cause the verifier flagged as the right one (a robust fit, not just a tighter radius). native/skotiq_native/imaging/src/stacking.rs:834-919 adds fit_transform_robust(): iterative median-based outlier rejection (3-sigma over the MEDIAN deviation, 1.5px floor, 5 passes, never clipping below 3 pairs) that refits after each clip and reports the RMS over the SURVIVING pairs. add_frame() calls it at :493-494 and rejects on too-few agreeing pairs (:496-511) before the residual gate. max_alignment_residual_px was then tightened 10.0 -> 2.0 (:94-100) - only meaningful once the residual measures inlier scatter rather than matcher mis-pairing.
test: 3 tests in native/skotiq_native/imaging/src/stacking.rs: mis_paired_stars_do_not_wreck_the_transform_fit (24 good + 4 mis-paired -> naive residual >5px asserted first, robust <0.5px and recovers the true translation), a_clean_match_set_keeps_every_pair (no over-clipping), add_frame_survives_a_matcher_cascade_from_missing_stars (end-to-end through add_frame, reproducing the greedy-matcher steal cascade). `cargo test -p skotiq_imaging --lib stacking::` = 27 passed.
revert_check: Severed the production call site at stacking.rs:493 - replaced `fit_transform_robust(...)` with the old `compute_affine_transform` + `compute_alignment_residual` over all matches. add_frame_survives_a_matcher_cascade_from_missing_stars failed with 'Alignment residual too high: 13.96px (max 2.00px)'. Restored, 27 pass, cargo fmt --check clean.
caveats: The 3 tests are synthetic reproductions of the reported geometry, not the original audit_L_*.fits (no longer on disk). The verifier's caveat (c) - that detect_stars returns 0 stars on audit_L_001.fits which an independent peak finder reads as 40 clean stars - is a SEPARATE detector defect and is not addressed by this fix. max_alignment_residual_px is never overridden from Dart, so the 2.0 default is what ships for both Stack & Share and the live EAA stacker.

title: The Share Card's metadata strip is clipped: it renders 'M51 Integration 00:35:00 Frames 7 Fil...'
summary: Closed by a later wave, at the location the verifier corrected to (share_card_renderer.dart, not stack_share_export_service.dart). :304-347 adds fitCaption(): it steps DOWN a font ladder (arial48/24/14) from the height-derived choice and greedy-wraps whole 'LABEL value' segments (:352-378, segments are never split) until every segment fits cardWidth - 2*pad in at most 3 rows. _drawBottomBar calls it at :475 and lays the bar out over the returned rows (:488-489 barHeight, :511-536 per-row draw), replacing the old single-row loop whose only width logic was `if (x >= bitmap.width - pad) break;`.
test: packages/skotiq_core/test/services/share_card_renderer_test.dart - 'no glyph is drawn in the right-hand padding of a 512px card' (renders the real PNG and scans the caption band for bright pixels) and 'every wrapped row measures within the card width, losing nothing' (asserts no segment is dropped).
revert_check: Severed the call site at share_card_renderer.dart:475: replaced the fitCaption result with `barFont = font; rows = [segments]` (the old single-row, height-only behaviour). Both tests failed - 'caption glyphs are being drawn into the right padding - the last stat is clipped'. Restored, 27 pass.

title: First Light's 'Could not load candidates' Retry button does not re-query
summary: Closed by a later wave, and downstream of the Retry button exactly where the verifier said the break was. Two halves: (1) transient_detections_provider.dart:149 now returns _localFirstLightStream(), which does a fresh one-shot `dao.recentDetections()` and only then joins the drift watch with `.skip(1)` (:153-176) - a re-subscription cannot replay a cached failure any more, and the skip stops the cached replay from undoing the fresh read; (2) transient_detections_dao.dart:95-111 _mapSkippingUndecodable drops a row the generated mapper cannot decode instead of failing the whole feed, and both watchRecentDetections (:79) and recentDetections (:128) use it. first_light_view.dart:405 also stops leading with the raw exception.
test: packages/skotiq_core/test/providers/first_light_candidates_resilience_test.dart - 4 tests, notably 'a fixed row is picked up by a re-subscription, not only by a restart' (writes the TEXT tile_id through customStatement, settles, corrects the row, invalidates, and asserts the provider never re-enters an error state).
revert_check: Two passes. (a) Reverted only the provider (:149 back to `.watchRecentDetections(...)`, DAO left fixed): 'a fixed row is picked up by a re-subscription' failed - so the fresh read is specifically what makes Retry work. (b) Reverting the DAO as well failed all 4. Restored, all 4 pass.
caveats: The `.skip(1)` in _localFirstLightStream has a narrow race: a write landing between the one-shot read and the watch subscription would be carried by the skipped initial snapshot and not surface until the next change notification. Window is one async gap; left as-is rather than churn. The finding's second claim (that the list is fetched once per app launch) remains unproven and unaddressed - the verifier explicitly declined to confirm it, since a sqlite3 edit from outside the process cannot notify drift's stream store either way.

title: In the Submit-discovery dialog all three network chips are dead on a default install, and only the selected network's blocker is explained
summary: Closed by a later wave, both halves. transient_report_panel.dart:134 passes `enabled: enabled` so an unavailable network reads as unavailable, and :149-171 renders _disabledNotices() - one line per blocked network (:389-408), collapsed to a single line when the detection itself is the shared blocker. The design-system half is real: skotiq_ui/lib/src/components/skotiq_chip.dart gained an `enabled` flag (:29) that dims fill/border/text, and :87-100 wraps a disabled chip in Semantics(button: true, enabled: false) plus a forbidden cursor - previously a null onTap rendered pixel-identically to an unpicked chip with no semantics at all.
test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/analytics/widgets/transient_report_reasons_test.dart (2 tests: all three chips report enabled == false and all three reasons are on screen with no interaction; an unconfirmed detection states its one shared blocker once) + packages/skotiq_ui/test/skotiq_chip_disabled_test.dart (5 tests).
revert_check: Removed `enabled: enabled` from the chip at transient_report_panel.dart:134 AND put the notice block back to the single `_disabledReason(_format, ...)` line. 'a disabled AAVSO and MPC chip each state their own reason' failed; restored, both pass.
